summary.zh-CN: 从近况、想法或一件事自然开始，并让最近会话、项目与工具继续服务长期协作。
summary.en-US: Start naturally from an update, an idea or an action, while recent conversations, projects and tools keep long-term work connected.

title.en-US: A starting point for long-term work

title.zh-CN: 从近况、想法或行动开始
title.en-US: Start from an update, idea or action

body.zh-CN: 新任务页提供开放式建议和相关最近会话；输入后自动收起建议，项目、Agent 与运行方式仍可随时切换。
body.en-US: The new-task page offers open-ended suggestions and relevant recent conversations. Suggestions clear as you type while project, Agent and runtime choices remain available.

title.en-US: New themes and a dedicated Apps page

body.zh-CN: 新增素笺与纸墨主题，并将应用市场改为保留搜索、浏览位置和页内详情的独立标签。
body.en-US: Plain Paper and Ink Paper themes arrive alongside a dedicated marketplace tab that preserves search, browsing position and inline details.

title.zh-CN: 更连续的阅读与工作台
title.en-US: More continuous reading and workspace flow

body.zh-CN: 展开详情时保持阅读位置，Markdown 支持动画 details、本地文件图标与公式提示；移动端报告全屏显示，并可回到来源会话继续聊天。
body.en-US: Expanded details preserve reading position, Markdown gains animated details, local file icons and formula guidance, and mobile reports fill the screen with a route back to the source conversation.

body.zh-CN: 聊天标题栏、弹窗、菜单、工作区面板、文件预览和侧栏控件采用更一致的间距、配色与键盘反馈。
body.en-US: Chat headers, dialogs, menus, workspace panels, file previews and sidebar controls now share more consistent spacing, color and keyboard feedback.

title.zh-CN: 保持输入与会话状态准确
title.en-US: Keep input and conversation state accurate

body.zh-CN: 已发送的中文输入不再写回草稿；位于底部时不再显示向下箭头；会话标题更早生成，并保护手动命名与更新较晚的输入。
body.en-US: Sent Chinese IME text no longer returns to the draft, the down arrow stays hidden at the bottom, and titles generate earlier while preserving manual names and newer input.

body.zh-CN: 现有配置和本地数据保持兼容；本版本同步提供 NPM、Runtime 与五平台桌面更新。
body.en-US: Existing configuration and local data remain compatible. This release ships through NPM, Runtime and five Desktop platforms.
